clues.title: Plate: European-style with blue strip, red taxis
text: Standard Lebanese licence plates are either long with a blue strip on the left, similar to most licence plates in Europe, or **short** with a similar blue strip. Licence plates on taxis are notably **deep red**. You may also find licence plates with [other colours](https://goo.gl/maps/oQN6Fvb8y2GSypoC6).

images.caption: Lebanese plates: standard, standard short and red taxi

clues.summary: Plates are long or short with a blue strip on the left. Taxi plates are deep red, and other colours exist too.

clues.title: Language: Arabic, plus English and French
text: The official language of Lebanon is **Arabic**, however [English](https://goo.gl/maps/wAohfpzv2g5ayJyy7) and [French](https://goo.gl/maps/JJ7RJ4cZ246BJksc9) are also common to see.
clues.summary: Arabic is the main script, but English and French are also common on signs.

clues.title: Coverage: low-quality camera, Middle East
text: Lebanon is currently the only Middle Eastern country that has official **shitcam coverage**.
clues.summary: Official coverage shot with a low-quality camera (blurry, poor colours). It is the only country in the Middle East with it.

clues.title: Coverage: older walking-backpack camera
text: Apart from the shitcam, all of the Lebanese coverage was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker**.
clues.summary: Apart from the low-quality camera, all coverage was shot with an older Gen 3 walking backpack (blurrier, softer colours).

clues.title: Landscape: Mediterranean hills and rocky cliffs
text: Lebanon has a **Mediterranean landscape**, with a lot of hills and rocky cliffs.
clues.summary: Mediterranean look with lots of hills and rocky cliffs.

clues.title: Pole: metal mesh, sometimes bright yellow
text: Lebanon uses a variety of **metallic mesh poles**, which are sometimes **painted bright yellow**. Generic-looking wooden poles are common too.
clues.summary: Many poles are metal mesh towers, sometimes painted bright yellow. Plain wooden poles are common too.

clues.title: Architecture: sandstone brick buildings
text: While several types of architecture can be found on the Lebanese coverage, it is worth mentioning that many buildings are made of **sandstone bricks**.

NOTE: These bricks often look very similar to [Jerusalem stone](https://www.google.com/maps/@31.8956347,35.198306,3a,75y,245.85h,124.16t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s21rJNnw9rW4MmPpgX4NHNw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu), commonly found in Israel and the West Bank.
clues.summary: Many buildings are made of sandstone bricks. They look much like Jerusalem stone, common in Israel and the West Bank.

differs.how: Jerusalem stone looks very similar to Lebanese sandstone

clues.title: Coverage: mostly near the west coast
text: Most of the coverage is concentrated near the west coast, north of Beirut.
clues.summary: Most coverage is near the west coast, north of the capital.

clues.title: Landscape: flat fields, mountains to the northwest
text: The region around Zahle has flat agricultural fields, with mountains visible to the northwest.
clues.summary: Flat farmland with mountains visible to the northwest. This is the region around Zahle.

clues.title: Coverage: snow on mountains
text: Coverage where **snow **is visible on mountain tops, or on the ground, is found in the northeastern mountains, east of Tripoli.
clues.summary: Snow on mountain tops or on the ground means the north-eastern mountains, east of Tripoli.

clues.title: Landscape: very flat farmland in the north
text: Northern Lebanon is **very flat** and **agricultural**. You might see the mountains to the southeast.
clues.summary: In the north the land is very flat and agricultural, with mountains maybe visible to the southeast.

clues.title: Google car: visible black car
text: A visible black car can be found in and around Zahle.

images.caption: Red oval marks the faint outline of the black Google car on the road

clues.summary: A black car showing at the bottom of the screen. It points to the area in and around Zahle.

clues.title: Coverage: rare backpack shots at attractions
text: The Generation 3 trekker coverage in Lebanon is **extremely limited**, mostly being found around tourist attractions, university campuses and trails. Note that due to the large number of distinct trekkers, this guide will only cover those that are considered pinpointable.
clues.summary: Backpack coverage is very limited and mostly at tourist sights, university campuses and trails. Only the places you can pinpoint are covered in these notes.

clues.title: Architecture: many modern high-rises
text: Beirut is the capital of Lebanon and the only covered city with many modern **high-rise buildings**. While the city might not be clearly visible from all parts of the coverage, you will almost always be able to see urban [buildings](https://goo.gl/maps/QbcXbyAKVZ5qwiFW6) or [infrastructure](https://goo.gl/maps/uLp9kfysBxmAr5Db9) in the background.
clues.summary: The only covered city with lots of modern high-rises. Even when not directly in view, city buildings or roads show in the background.

clues.title: Coverage: seaside promenade, grey bricks, fan palms
text: Coverage was taken along parts of the promenade in Beirut, with a grey brick pavement and a large number of fan palms.
clues.summary: A promenade with grey brick paving and many fan palms. This is part of the capital's seafront.

clues.title: Architecture: grand old sandstone building
text: Université Saint Joseph, southeast of central Beirut can be recognised by the old, **grand-looking** **sandstone building**.
clues.summary: An old, grand-looking sandstone building. It is a university south-east of the capital centre.

clues.title: Architecture: modern sandstone on a forested hill
text: Campus Debbieh of the Beirut Arab University consists of somewhat sparsely built large **modern sandstone buildings** on top of a forested hill. [The ocean](https://goo.gl/maps/JABVUYU4L9Zztrxm8) can typically be seen far away to the west.
clues.summary: Large modern sandstone buildings, spread out on a forested hill, with the sea far away to the west. It is a university campus.

clues.title: Architecture: stone bottom floors, beige above
text: The Lebanese International University (LIU) can be recognised by the many large stone buildings having unpainted bottom floors while the floors above are painted beige.
clues.summary: Large stone buildings with unpainted bottom floors and beige-painted floors above. It is a university campus.

clues.title: Architecture: cubic white-painted buildings
text: The University of Balamand has a lot of modern **white painted buildings**. The buildings often have a very cubic look.
clues.summary: Lots of modern white-painted buildings with a very boxy look. It is a university campus.

clues.title: Architecture: urban campus, construction, big blocks
text: The Lebanese American University, east of Byblos, has a very **urban look**, with a lot of construction work and large modern buildings.
clues.summary: A campus with an urban feel: lots of construction work and large modern buildings. It lies east of the ancient coastal city.

clues.title: Architecture: old buildings of unpainted stone brick
text: The ancient city of Byblos is one of the oldest cities in the world and can be recognised by the many **old historical buildings**, almost all built out of the same type of unpainted stone bricks.
clues.summary: Many old historical buildings, almost all made from the same unpainted stone bricks. It is one of the oldest cities in the world.

clues.title: Landscape: large canyon to the south
text: The trekker near Bsharri can be recognised by the **large canyon** to the south.
clues.summary: A large canyon visible to the south. The walker is near Bsharri.

clues.title: Landmark: large Roman ruins
text: In Baalbek you can find a large complex of **Roman ruins**.
clues.summary: A big complex of Roman ruins. It is in Baalbek.

clues.title: Landmark: fortress on a single limestone rock
text: The Mseilha fortress can be found southwest of Tripoli and is built on a monolithic limestone rock.
clues.summary: A fortress built on one huge limestone rock. It lies south-west of Tripoli.

clues.title: Coverage: only rural coastal road with walker shots
text: The only **rural coastal road** with trekker coverage in Lebanon can be found southwest of Tripoli.
clues.summary: The only countryside coastal road with walking-backpack coverage in the country. It is south-west of Tripoli.
